source.author: verg
source.text: Haec memorans animo nunc huc, nunc fluctuat illuc, an sese mucrone ob tantum dedecus amens induat et crudum per costas exigat ensem, fluctibus an iaciat mediis et litora nando curva petat Teucrumque iterum se reddat in arma.
source.text_original: Haec memorans animo nunc huc, nunc fluctuat illuc, / an sese mucrone ob tantum dedecus amens / induat et crudum per costas exigat ensem, / fluctibus an iaciat mediis et litora nando / curva petat Teucrumque iterum se reddat in arma.
source.text_english: Recalling these things in her mind, now this way, now that she wavers, whether in madness for so great a shame she should put on the sword’s point and drive the cruel blade through her ribs, or cast herself amid the waves and seek the curving shore by swimming and once again return herself to the Teucrian arms.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: fluctibus e mediis terras dabit ille magistro et dabit astra rati, cumque aethera Iuppiter umbra perdiderit, solus transibit nubila Lynceus.
reuse.text_original: fluctibus e mediis terras dabit ille magistro / et dabit astra rati, cumque aethera Iuppiter umbra / perdiderit, solus transibit nubila Lynceus.
reuse.text_english: He will give lands from the midst of the waves to the helmsman, and he will give the stars to the ship, and when Jupiter has lost the sky in shadow, Lynceus alone will pass through the clouds.
